components.css: .ds-detail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}.ds-check{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;min-height:1.5rem;color:var(--fg);font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.35;cursor:pointer}.ds-check-input,.ds-sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}.ds-check-control{display:grid;flex:0 0 1.1rem;place-items:center;width:1.1rem;height:1.1rem;border:1px solid var(--border-control);border-radius:.25rem;background:var(--surface-input)}.ds-check-control svg{display:none}.ds-check-input:checked+.ds-check-control{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#16120a}.ds-check-input:checked+.ds-check-control svg{display:block}.ds-check-input:focus-visible+.ds-check-control{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}.ds-size{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.3rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem}.ds-size input{width:4.5rem;min-width:0;min-height:2rem;padding:.3rem .5rem;border:1px solid var(--border-control);border-radius:.45rem;background:var(--surface-input);color:var(--fg);caret-color:var(--accent);font:inherit;font-size:.85rem}.ds-size input::placeholder{color:var(--muted);opacity:1}.ds-size input:hover{border-color:var(--muted)}.ds-size button{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:1.6rem;height:1.6rem;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--border-control);border-radius:.35rem;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer}.ds-size input:focus-visible,.ds-size button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}.ds-size button[hidden]{visibility:hidden;display:inline-grid}.ds-size input:disabled{opacity:.5}

narrative.overview:
A matte printed-playmat world: teal fields, deep ink working zones, ivory lettering and yellow moments of action. Thin rules divide continuous surfaces rather than making every item a floating card. Landing display lettering is expressive; the streaming workspace translates the same materials into quiet, compact controls.

The shared palette does not imply identical typography or density. The landing uses self-hosted Bricolage Grotesque for headings; the app uses the system UI stack for operative text. The display face is not loaded by the app entry point.
keyCharacteristics: Matte tonal zones with thin, visible boundaries.
Yellow actions and selected controls against ink and teal.
Expressive landing headings; restrained, labelled app controls.
SVG iconography and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Yellow Has Work Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks actions, selected controls and live editing or result information; it is not restricted to buttons.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Keep Bricolage's expressive landing headings distinct from the app's compact system UI hierarchy.

rules.name: The Mat Before Lift Rule
rules.body: Use tonal zones and rules for interface depth; reserve the physical-card shadow for the illustrative object.

rules.name: The Continuous Preview Rule
rules.body: Switching panels changes the settings view without unmounting either the camera stage or preview iframe.

dos: Do retain matte tonal zones, thin boundaries and stronger input edges.
Do use the expressive landing and restrained app type registers for their established roles.
Do keep camera and iframe mounted while settings panels switch.
Do keep detail-size overrides inline with their checkbox and retain accessible labels.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, SVG controls and reduced-motion fallbacks.
donts: Don't turn the illustrative card's soft shadow into app panel elevation.
Don't replace the app's labelled native controls with decorative display treatments.
Don't hide the landing launch action with secondary mobile navigation.
Don't turn illustration microtype into a reusable body-text size.
